policy.preference: Prefer commercially redistributable (core) sources for the product path. Extra (NC/research) sources may enrich private local use and stay swappable.
policy.frontendRule: Simple layperson UI; heavy data stays in backend modules.

layers.extra: Private/NC/research enrichment; do not ship in a commercial build without clearance

sources.name: German IPIP translations (Asselmann et al.)
sources.notes: Use for private enrichment; own DE wording remains core fallback.

sources.name: O*NET Database
sources.notes: RIASEC profiles per occupation. Attribution required. O*NET® trademark rules apply.

sources.notes: Prefer API / unmodified Mini-IP for product path. Modified pictorial items are separate own constructions.

sources.name: ESCO classification
